name: DigitalCube Popup Builder
author: digitalcubedesigns

sections.description:
DigitalCube Popup Builder is the no-bloat popup plugin that gives you for FREE what others put behind a paywall:

  • FREE exit-intent trigger — catch visitors before they leave (desktop + mobile fallback)
  • FREE built-in analytics — views, clicks, CTR, conversions, dismissals & device breakdown
  • Block-editor native — build popup content with the blocks you already know, plus ready-made patterns & starter templates
  • Accessibility-first — focus trap, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, ESC to close, reduced-motion support
  • Annoyance Guard — automatically pauses a popup for visitors who dismissed it twice
  • Lightweight — tiny dependency-free JavaScript, zero jQuery, zero layout shift
  • Privacy-friendly — analytics stored in YOUR database, no external calls, no raw IPs

Popup types (free)

  • Lightbox modal
  • Slide-in (bottom right)
  • Sticky bar (top or bottom)
  • Fullscreen welcome mat
  • Toast notification

Triggers

  • Time delay
  • Scroll depth (%)
  • Exit intent (free!)
  • Click on any element (CSS selector)

Targeting & scheduling

  • Entire site / homepage only / include or exclude specific posts & pages
  • Desktop / mobile targeting
  • Frequency: every view, once per session, once every N days
  • Smart scheduling: start & end date-time for campaigns

DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro (optional add-on)

Want more? The separate DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro add-on unlocks:

  • WhatsApp chat popups
  • Spin-to-Win gamified wheel
  • A/B testing (50/50 split with CTR comparison)
  • WooCommerce dynamic one-time coupons + revenue attribution
  • AI copy generator (bring your own OpenAI-compatible API key)
  • Ads & conversion tracking — Meta Pixel, Google (GA4/Ads) & GTM dataLayer, with UTM campaign attribution

DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro installs alongside this free plugin and activates with a license key. The free plugin never nags and works fully on its own.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the popkit folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate DigitalCube Popup Builder through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to Popups → Add New Popup, design your popup with blocks (try the DigitalCube Popup Builder templates!), choose a trigger, and publish.
sections.faq:
Does the free version include exit-intent?

Yes! Exit-intent is 100% free — forever.

Where is analytics data stored?

In your own WordPress database. DigitalCube Popup Builder makes no external calls and stores no raw IP addresses.

What needs DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro?

WhatsApp popups, spin-to-win, A/B testing, WooCommerce coupons, AI copy and ad-platform conversion tracking. Everything else is free.

Will popups slow my site down?

No. DigitalCube Popup Builder ships a tiny dependency-free script, loads it only on pages where a popup is active, and uses position:fixed rendering for zero layout shift.

  • New: added Plugin URI and Author URI headers so the plugin links to its directory page and author profile.
  • Housekeeping: no functional changes to popups, analytics or the block editor.

0.3.1

  • New: “Upgrade to Pro” page under Popups (after Analytics) — shows the DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro features with a link to the plans & pricing page. Automatically hidden once DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro is active.

0.3.0

  • Architecture: DigitalCube Popup Builder is now a free, self-contained core with a clean add-on API. Premium features (WhatsApp, spin-to-win, A/B testing, WooCommerce coupons, AI copy, ads tracking) moved to the separate DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro add-on
  • New: extension hooks (popkit_loaded, popkit_default_settings, popkit_popup_types, popkit_meta_render, popkit_frontend_config, popkit_js_config, popkit_popup_inner, popkit_settings_sections, popkit_analytics_after_table, and more) so add-ons extend the core without touching it
  • Improved: free core has no license nag and works fully on its own

0.2.7

  • New: Ads & conversion tracking — fire popup events to Meta Pixel, Google (GA4/Ads gtag) and GTM dataLayer
  • New: UTM attribution — every view/click/conversion records utm_source & utm_campaign
  • New: Analytics “Ad campaign attribution” table showing which ad drove conversions

0.2.6

  • New: “Create your own template” — save any popup as a reusable template; star ⭐ a primary template; “Use a Template” button on All Popups

0.2.5

  • New: “Show close (×) button” toggle per popup (ESC key still always closes for accessibility)

0.2.4

  • New: Templates page inside the plugin menu with visual preview cards and one-click “Use This Template”

0.2.3

  • New: 7 premium redesigned templates — gradient backgrounds, bold typography, urgency & social proof

0.2.2

  • New: ready-made templates, analytics device breakdown, “Ignore my own visits” + IP exclusion list

0.2.1

  • New: per-popup padding control (0 = edge-to-edge color) and width control; fixed stray margins

0.2.0

  • New: WhatsApp, Spin-to-Win, Toast types; A/B testing; WooCommerce coupons & revenue; smart scheduling; AI copy; block patterns (now part of DigitalCube Popup Builder Pro as of 0.3.0)

0.1.0

  • Initial release: block-native builder, 5 popup types, 4 triggers, display rules, frequency capping, Annoyance Guard, built-in analytics dashboard, accessibility baseline.
